title: fix(metadata-protocol,service-analytics)!: a read that follows a lookup asks the target object its declared exposure — $expand and the dataset label passes (#22661)
body:
Part of #22661

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

## Summary

A read that follows a lookup reaches a SECOND object nobody addressed. The data routes judge the addressed object's `enable` block through the spec's one exposure decision (`apiExposureDenialReason` / `canServeApiOperation`, ADR-0049); two second-object reads never asked the target. Class ① product defect, `security`. Class, position and function level only; the fixture-object pins carry the shapes.

- **Data door `$expand`** (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.servedExpand` / `servesExpansionTarget`, called from `findData` and `getData`): every level of the expand tree asks the decision of that level's TARGET, for `get`. An entry it does not serve is withheld, so the field answers as an unexpanded lookup (its stored id) and nothing below it is read. One intake covers the list, single-record, query and export routes and the runtime dispatcher, which all hand `expand` to this door.
- **Dataset door dimension labels** (`@objectstack/service-analytics`, `servesLabelTarget` in `api-exposure-door.ts`, applied by `withServedLabelTargets` around the configured label resolver in the `AnalyticsService` constructor): the display pass and the sort-key pass read only a target the decision serves for `get`; otherwise the stored id renders and an `order` sorts by it.

No new error code, no new rule, no second list: both reads ask the same spec function. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`: no accept set grows, and two read doors narrow. The arm was added by the seat after the contract review; the value is the claim's.

## Why `get`, for both

Both reads turn an id the caller already holds into the record it names, which is the read the single-record data route performs, judged `get`. The expansion sub-read is bounded to `id $in` the source rows' own values, so a nested `where` only narrows records the caller could fetch by id; the label read is a per-record read dressed as an aggregate (one row per grouped id). Asking `get` on both doors means a lookup renders its name, or its stored id, alike on the data door and the dataset door for every `apiMethods` shape. A relationship-hop dimension is a different read (it groups by a target column) and stays judged `aggregate` over `queryObjects`, unchanged.

## Precedent (measured, then followed)

On `origin/main` `eae3368a`, a related record the member may not READ was answered by the expansion as the bare foreign key, and by the label pass as the raw id. The unexposed target now answers the same way: withheld, not refused. A declaration the label pass cannot read withholds the labels (fail-closed, logged at `warn`); the query still answers.

## Placement

At the generic data door, not in `ObjectQL.expandRelatedRecords`: exposure is a property of the API, and the engine's privileged callers (a flow's `config.expand`, a hook's own read) never pass the door, the split #7823 drew for write results and #22646 for the evaluate positions. The withhold runs before the `internal: true` expand walk, so nothing about a withheld target is judged or named.

## Census (real stack, fixture objects, administrator and member)

Measured through `@objectstack/verify` `bootStack` (real SecurityPlugin, ObjectQL, SQL driver, REST, auth, analytics; approvals and audit plugins where named). Targets: off switch, a whitelist granting no read, `list` only, `get` only, no `enable`; plus a target the member may not read (the precedent leg).

| # | Second-object read (function) | Before, `eae3368a` | After, this branch | Disposition |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | Data door `$expand`, every route and level (`expandRelatedRecords`, reached through `findData` / `getData`) | unexposed targets served, both personas | withheld (stored id), both personas; served targets unchanged | fixed here |
| 2 | Dataset display-label pass (`resolveDimensionLabels` via `fetchRecordLabels`) | unexposed targets' names served | stored id renders | fixed here |
| 3 | Dataset sort-key label pass (`createOrderLabelResolver`) | ordered by the unexposed target's names | ordered by stored id | fixed here |
| 4 | Data door nested-relation filter condition (`ObjectQL.lowerRelationConditions`) | evaluated: the source row comes back only when the related value matches | unchanged | open, #22737 |
| 5 | Approvals inbox `payload_display` (`ApprovalService.enrichRows`, system read of referenced titles) | unexposed target's title served | unchanged | open, #22738 |
| 6 | Activity timeline tracked-change summary (`resolveLookupTitles`, write-time) | unexposed target's title served | unchanged | open, #22738 |
| 7 | Import door reference resolution (`import-runner.ts` `resolveRef`) | display text matched against an unexposed target; the matched id is stored, a miss reported per row | unchanged | open, #22739 |

Why 4 to 7 are not in this PR: a filter cannot be withheld, so row 4's answer is a refusal in the data door's exposure codes, which needs a provenance row for the door and touches a filter position, both outside this claim's surface; rows 5 to 7 live in other packages and lanes. The seat filed them under this card as #22737 (row 4), #22738 (rows 5 and 6) and #22739 (row 7), which is why this PR says `Part of`.

**Reach.** Read on `origin/main` `eae3368a` over every `.ts` source under `packages/` and `examples/`: ten objects refuse `get` by declaration, and exactly one lookup points into any of them, from an object that is itself `apiEnabled: false` (control: the same pattern finds 88 lookups into `sys_user` and 45 into `sys_organization`). No example declares `enable.apiEnabled` or `enable.apiMethods`. So no shipped object's served answer changes; an application can author one. Deployed and cloud-held definitions NOT MEASURED.

## Pins

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.expand-target-exposure.test.ts` (15): every withheld shape on the comma list and the relation map, second level, no-mutation of the caller's map, a system context withheld from too, the single-record read; controls `get`-only and no-`enable` reach the engine unchanged.
- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/dimension-label-exposure.test.ts` (12): both label passes per withheld shape, never reading the target; controls; the fail-closed leg; the no-probe stand-down.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/second-object-exposure.dogfood.test.ts` (25, real stack, both personas): armed against each target's own single-record answer (404 / 405 / 200), the three `$expand` spellings, second level, export, both label passes, the unchanged precedent.
- `packages/core/src/security/second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` (4, `repo` project): the enumeration. Every non-test caller of `referenceTargetOf` (the spec's one arbiter of a lookup's target) is classified as decided, executed-for-a-door, open, or not a served read; an unclassified caller, or a decided read whose decision function stops asking the decision, turns it red. Its blind spots (targets not resolved through the arbiter) are named in its header.

## Ablations (each committed first, restored and proven `git diff HEAD` empty)

Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; anchors hit 1 to 0 each, blobs changed and restored to HEAD.

- Door decision bypassed: protocol pin 12 red / 3 green (the controls and the no-mutation case).
- Label decision bypassed: analytics pin 8 red / 4 green; the fail-closed branch bypassed: 1 red.
- Both bypassed, rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in both `dist/`: dogfood pin 14 red / 11 green (every withheld leg, both personas); restore leg rebuilt, both markers `--absent` exit 0, tree clean.
- Enumeration pin: a planted unclassified caller, 1 red naming it; the decision function replaced by a hand-spelled rule, 1 red.

## Verification (final tree `d08c27bedf`, `origin/main` merged)

- metadata-protocol: vitest 224 files / 28116 passed (19 skipped); typecheck exit 0, the new test in its program. Run at `25abc95652`; the later `origin/main` merge touched neither this package nor service-analytics, and at `d08c27bedf` the new pin re-ran 15/15.
- service-analytics: vitest 183 files / 4497 passed (262 skipped); typecheck exit 0, the new test in its program. Run at `25abc95652`; at `d08c27bedf` the new pin with the label-order and exposure-door suites re-ran 3 files / 52 passed.
- core: `repo` project 5 files / 55 passed; typecheck (with test-typecheck) exit 0, at `d08c27bedf`.
- dogfood: the new pin and the label-scope pin, 27 passed at `d08c27bedf` after a post-merge rebuild; the two new files type-checked in a scoped program. The rest of dogfood is CI's.
- Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 81 at `d08c27bedf`; all 81 exit 0; `--ran` reconciles 81 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET and was re-run after a full build (72 tasks).
- Lint, narrowed: `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 9 changed `.ts` files, all inside the config's population (5 to 6 active rules each); `--format json` 9 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings; the config enables no type-aware linting, so no untouched file's verdict can move. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- `import-field-meta.ts` reads a reference field's target off the raw `reference` carrier rather than `referenceTargetOf` (the arbiter the rest of the census uses); carried by #22739 (row 7), whose fix reads the target through `referenceTargetOf`.
- Fixed platform targets (`sys_file` hydration, `sys_user` display names) are second-object reads with no authored target; both objects declare no `enable` block today. Named in the enumeration pin's header, not held.
